A letter

Just for you

Dear Mahima,

No matter where we are or what we're doing, time with you makes me feel peaceful and close to you. Being with you is one of the best parts of my life, and I'm so grateful for all the moments we share.

This birthday means a lot to me too, because getting to celebrate you is one of my favourite things. I made this little world just for you. Take your time with the photos, open the little notes, and save those three wishes for whenever you like.

Happy Birthday, my sweet butterfly. I love you.

Raj
